Nora Fatehi responds to dating rumors with Moroccan footballer

Actress Nora Fatehi has responded to rumors linking her romantically with Moroccan footballer Yassine Bono. When asked about dating him, Fatehi reportedly blushed and stated that he is a wonderful person. She described Bono as a good friend and one of the world's best goalkeepers.
